reviews.text: We love Georgi. Romi’s not always an easy dog to walk. Georgi’s been consistently patient and understanding with her. Romi comes back happy and knackered after her adventure walks with Georgi. And they have a great relationship. Georgi’s got some good people working with her too. She runs a good operation. Wholeheartedly recommend cwtches!

We came to Cwtches with a reactive Romanian rescue dog who was having trouble going on walks without lunging and barking at other dogs. Within 3 sessions our lovely rescue girl was socialising really nicely with other dogs, and able to listen to us and focus on our voices even when triggers were around. She now adores her walks and they're much less stressful for us as well! She's even been on one of Georgi's group walks and loved it, so we'd highly recommend Georgi's services as both a behaviourist and a dog walker. Thank you Georgi!

Georgi is amazing! It took us a long time to find someone that we trusted with our dog and we are delighted that we found Georgi.
Georgi and her team genuinely care about the dogs they are walking, they learn their personalities and make sure the walks work for them.
Our dog, Bailey, loves his adventures. He’s always super excited to get going and comes back exhausted and clearly fulfilled.
We couldn’t recommend Cwtches Dog more!!

I cannot recommend Georgi highly enough.  She is the second local dog behaviourist we have used and we feel so grateful to have found her as she absolutely gets us and our
very nervous rescue dog and is helping us - with patience and generosity of spirit - navigate our way through some very tricky times settling the dog into family life.  Our dog also loves going on the walks with Georgi, her team and her doggy pals who she is beginning to gain lots of confidence from.  We are so pleased that we found Cwtches when we were feeling pretty desperate.  She is the best around to handle any dog but especially great with a reacue.

We LOVE using Georgi’s services for our 11 month border collie pup Stevie. We first met her at the pupstars class and the way she engaged with our (extremely distracted and disruptive!) puppy in the classes was delightful

We were so happy when she offered to do regular walks with Stevie. Over the past 6 months Georgis walks have taught Stevie how to be a responsive and well socialised dog and taught us how to be good dog owners too. I dont know how we would have negotiated our first year of having a puppy without her.

Her prices are EXTREMELY good value too!

Our Bouvier des Flanders, DIPA, absolutely ADORES Georgi and the Cwtches Crew. DIPA is always excited to go on her daily walkies and they have really shown her extra love while her pawrents have been adapting to a new human family member at home. Couldn't recommend them enough. 10/10.

Georgi is an absolute star! Our puppy struggled with anxiety and reactivity which made it difficult for us to trust her being left with other people. After a few visits with Georgi we were amazed to see her confidence improve and social skills with other dogs increase drastically. She now goes on adventure walks multiple times a week and has grown into a confident and happy adult dog. Truly a top notch service!

Georgi has been absolutely brilliant with our Portuguese Water Dog, Theo. He has responded so well to her positive training methods and he loves going on walks with her and comes back a very happy dog! Georgi has helped us to grow in confidence as owners and we would highly recommend her services! We are so grateful to her (and so is Theo!)
Eva, John and family

Georgi is a brilliant trainer and dog walker. She looks after my dogs brilliantly and keeps their human in check.

One of mine has had a tough time feeling confident and trusting other dogs she understands him and me and he’s the happiest boy when out with her. She knows my training preferences align with hers and knows how to get the best out of doggos that need a little more time.

Thanks for all you do! More adventure walks await 🦮🐕‍🦺🐾
